missing_information_behavior: If any required context is unknown, do not issue a positive recommendation; request clarification or professional review.
safety_exclusions: Do not recommend or alter prescribed antithrombotic therapy; distinguish ordinary dietary intake from concentrated supplement doses.
professional_escalation_conditions: Active bleeding, anticoagulant or antiplatelet use, planned surgery, atrial fibrillation or high-dose omega-3 use.
population_and_context: People with bleeding disorders, anticoagulant/antiplatelet exposure or upcoming surgery considering EPA/DHA.
dose_constraints: No dose; retain existing safety override and require clinician review.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Omega-3 fact sheet; assess dose-dependent bleeding evidence and product-specific EPA/DHA content. This rule remains draft; source passage extraction, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional approval are required before activation.
